messagingGuides.documentName: [EXTERNAL] OpenShift Virtualization with Cohesity Messaging Guide
messagingGuides.summary: This messaging guide outlines the key benefits and talking points for the integrated solution of Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization with Cohesity DataProtect. It highlights how this collaboration enhances data resiliency, streamlines operations, and provides a scalable platform for modern virtualized environments.
keyPoints: Cohesity DataProtect increases data resiliency and protects Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization VMs and data, addressing challenges of modern virtualized environments.
The integrated solution offers a scalable platform that strengthens data protection, enhances security, and streamlines operations.
Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization provides a unified, scalable platform for migrating VMs, enabling modernization and consistent management across hybrid cloud environments.
Improve operational efficiency and scale for data protection through centralized management, scalable architecture, and automated workflows.
Ensure data is properly protected and can be restored quickly with advanced ransomware protection, compliance, governance capabilities, and instant mass restore functionality (future).

Achieve consistent data management and protection across environments with optimized performance and unified protection for VMs and containerized applications, including future hybrid and multi-cloud support.
